defect: The new ASSERT_EQ lines compare unsigned option fields (uint32_t/size_t) with signed int and long long literals, producing sign-compare errors that break the clang -Werror build.
reason: The fix only changes the literals in lines this change added to unsigned types, repairing a compile failure on a supported compiler.

defect: The change added a SUPPRESS_TSAN attribute to silence TSAN reports; the fix removes it after rewriting the callers' conditional expressions to avoid the apparently spurious warning.
reason: The fix removes a sanitizer suppression and re-enables TSAN tests; no wrong result, crash or build failure in the change's lines is repaired.

defect: The change turns the single background thread into a pool of num_threads_ workers but keeps signalling the condition variable only when the queue is empty, so tasks enqueued while the queue is non-empty wake no idle worker and run serially on one thread.
reason: The wakeup rule was correct only for one worker; the thread pool added by this change makes it lose wakeups, and the fix signals on every Schedule.

defect: The per-edit printing block using verbose and count was inserted into VersionSet::Recover, where neither variable exists, instead of DumpManifest, breaking compilation.
reason: The fix moves exactly these added lines into DumpManifest to repair the compile error its message attributes to this change.

defect: The fix stops writing range tombstones that start exactly at the next file's lower bound when the files do not share an endpoint; the < 0 comparison it changes came from the later commit 3a4bd36fe, while this change used <= 0.
reason: The over-inclusion of tombstones was introduced by an intermediate commit; this change's comparison already excluded such tombstones.

defect: The test added here asserts that async read bytes are counted whenever ROCKSDB_IOURING_PRESENT is defined, which fails when io_uring is unavailable at runtime (e.g. under valgrind); the fix makes the expectation depend on whether io_uring was actually used.
reason: The fix is a test-only change of an over-strict assertion; no product code defect is repaired.

defect: obsolete_manifests_.emplace_back runs in LogAndApply while the DB mutex is released (before mu->Lock()), racing with GetObsoleteFiles, which swaps the vector under the mutex.
reason: The fix moves exactly this added push to after mu->Lock(), repairing the data race introduced here.

defect: The added ASSERT_EQ(int_num, 0) and ASSERT_EQ(int_num, 4) compare a uint64_t with signed int literals, causing a sign-compare error that breaks the mac clang -Werror build.
reason: The fix changes these two added lines to unsigned literals to repair the compile error.

defect: In this file the fix only adds static_cast<int> to bool arguments printed with %d, which is harmless because bool promotes to int; the actual share_table_files bug was a missing initializer in the pre-existing BackupableDBOptions constructor in the header.
reason: The repaired defect predates this change and lies in another file; the edit to this change's lines is cosmetic.

defect: The fix casts the lseek and write arguments to satisfy MSVC warning C4244, which was enabled only months later (commits 236fe21c9/3fa68af31) for the Windows port.
reason: The code was fine for the configurations supported at the time; the fix adapts it to a warning enabled later.

defect: The fix commit, titled as fixing rebase issues, puts Version::Get back to the older signature without key_exists/seq, a rebase artifact rather than a repair of a defect in this change.
reason: Nothing in the parameters this change added was wrong; the later diff is merge/rebase cleanup.

defect: The added fprintf prints the size_t block_size with %lu, a format mismatch on 32-bit platforms that triggers -Wformat and fails the default -Werror build on linux32.
reason: The fix replaces exactly this added format specifier with ROCKSDB_PRIszt.

defect: The rewritten CompressionStatsTest hard-codes exact block counts and a 0.95 compressibility that only hold for snappy, so it fails when another compressor is picked; the fix loops over supported compressions and uses random binary data.
reason: The fix is a test-only change of over-specific expectations; no product code defect is repaired.

defect: The fix removes an unused outer val_slice, which became unused only when the later commit b73fbbaf6 (--no_value) declared a shadowing val_slice inside the else branch.
reason: In this change val_slice was used, so the warning was introduced by the intermediate commit.

defect: The change raised the deletion rate in WALTrashCleanupOnOpen from 1 to 1 MB/s although the comment says the slow rate is meant to keep a .log.trash file, making the test flaky; the fix restores the rate of 1.
reason: The fix is a test-only change restoring a test parameter; no product code defect is repaired.

defect: The fix redesigns the ASSERT macros so failures abort immediately instead of in ~Tester, to silence scan-build null-dereference reports; the added ASSERT_NOK merely follows the existing pattern.
reason: The destructor-based termination predates this change, and the fix is a test-harness redesign.

defect: AtomicFlushMemTablesToOutputFiles now treats ShutdownInProgress (used for both CF drop and real DB shutdown) like success, and the directory Fsync overwrites that status with OK, so flush results and superversions are installed while the DB is shutting down, hitting an assertion.
reason: The fix changes exactly the s.ok() || s.IsShutdownInProgress() handling added here so that results are not installed on a real shutdown.

defect: The added assert(fileOffset < dataSize) in BlockAccessCipherStream::Decrypt compares two unrelated quantities and fires in debug builds whenever data is read at a file offset beyond the read length.
reason: The fix removes exactly this added assertion, which broke the encrypted-env tests.

defect: The format string for write_buffer_size was typed as zu% instead of %zu, leaving a trailing % and an unused argument, which is undefined behaviour and fails -Wformat under -Werror.
reason: The fix corrects exactly this typo added by the change.

defect: The added MyComparator::Compare uses rocksdb::Slice inside ROCKSDB_NAMESPACE, which does not compile when ROCKSDB_NAMESPACE is set to another namespace, a CI-tested configuration.
reason: The fix replaces rocksdb::Slice with Slice in this added line.

defect: The constructor parameter db_impl of the added local class PublishSeqCallback shadows the enclosing db_impl variable, which fails the -Wshadow -Werror build.
reason: The fix renames the parameter in this added line to repair the compile error.

defect: By removing the L0-size adjustment of the base level in CalculateBaseBytes while scaling the L0 score by 10, the change lets the L0 score become very large when L0 is big, so L0->L1 compaction starves L1->L2 and data gets stuck in L1.
reason: The fix rewrites the L0 scoring added here and names this change as the cause of the regression.

defect: The added no-thread-local IOSTATS_CPU_TIMER_GUARD expands to nothing and ignores its env argument, leaving the env_ field in file_reader_writer.h unused and failing the clang -Werror (-Wunused-private-field) build for iOS/LITE.
reason: The fix changes exactly this added macro to evaluate env; before the change that configuration failed for another reason, but the remaining error lies in the line this change added.

defect: The fix casts props_block_handle.size() to size_t for 32-bit builds; this line was moved unchanged by the refactor from ReadPropertiesBlock into TryReadPropertiesWithGlobalSeqno.
reason: The implicit 64-to-32 conversion existed before this change.

defect: The added catch clauses name exception variables e that are never used, producing unreferenced-variable warnings that fail the MSVC (Appveyor) build.
reason: The fix removes the unused names in exactly these added lines.

defect: GenerateFileLevels hard-codes two input levels, which was correct when this change was made; it became wrong when commit 317851015 let Compaction take input files from more levels.
reason: The defect was introduced by the later multi-level refactor, not by this change.

defect: The change disables file deletions only after waiting for pending purges, so already-scheduled purges can still delete WALs during the scan; the fix disables deletions first and always waits for pending purges.
reason: The race existed before this change, which only partially fixed it; the fix completes a pre-existing bug fix rather than repairing a defect introduced here.

defect: In this file the fix only replaces C-style casts with static_cast; the clang error it addresses was in partitioned_filter_block_test.cc.
reason: The edit to this change's lines is stylistic and repairs no defect.

defect: The added assert(blob_entry.GetValue()->size() == value_size) fails for compressed blobs, since value_size is the on-disk (compressed) size while the cache holds the uncompressed value.
reason: The fix removes exactly this added assertion after crash-test failures.

defect: The fix changes size to uint64_t because GetFileSize takes a uint64_t pointer; the size_t declaration predates this change, which only added the initializer.
reason: The type mismatch that breaks the mac build existed before this change.

defect: The new NeedsCompaction overloads take MutableCFOptions from the super version, but NeedsCompaction can run before the super version is installed, so reading the options crashes with SIGSEGV.
reason: The fix reverts exactly these added signatures and bodies to the previous score-based check.

defect: The added const int key_len = compact_opt.output_file_size_limit / 5 implicitly narrows a uint64_t to int, which fails the clang -Wshorten-64-to-32 -Werror build.
reason: The fix changes exactly this added line.

defect: The fix makes Version::Get resolve blob references for GetEntity (columns) as well as Get; the missing columns handling predates this change, which only changed the key passed to GetBlob.
reason: The GetEntity blob-reference bug was not introduced by this change.

defect: The added Dump line prints inplace_update_num_locks, which is not a member of MutableCFOptions at this commit, so the file does not compile.
reason: The fix, titled as fixing an error during merge, removes exactly this added line.

defect: The added FIFOCompactionWithTTLTest relied on real sleeps of a few seconds and short TTLs, which made it flaky so it was disabled; the fix uses a fake clock and longer TTLs.
reason: The fix is a test-only change; no product code defect is repaired.

defect: createNewSlice1 makes the Slice point at the elements returned by GetByteArrayElements and then releases them with JNI_COMMIT, which leaks a copied buffer and leaves the Slice pointing at memory the JVM does not keep pinned.
reason: The fix copies the bytes into an owned buffer and releases with JNI_ABORT in exactly this added function.

defect: The fix allows BlobDB with user timestamps in the stress test and skips iter_start_ts for blob files; this change enabled Merge with timestamps and kept the BlobDB restriction.
reason: The fix is a test-configuration change for a combination this change did not enable.

defect: The added test declares std::array<uint64_t, 2> without the file including <array>, which fails to compile on mac with clang.
reason: The fix replaces exactly this added declaration with a raw array.

defect: The added argument dereferences table_properties_->user_defined_timestamps_persisted although table_properties_ can be null (the surrounding code checks it), crashing sst_dump in the crash test.
reason: The fix adds the null check to exactly this added line.

defect: The added f && check followed by an unconditional f->fd.GetNumber() makes the clang static analyzer report a possible null dereference; f is never null, and the fix replaces the check with assert(f).
reason: The fix silences a static-analysis false positive; no runtime defect is repaired.
